newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures slip on technical selling.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures slip on technical selling.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower on Thursday, pressured by technical selling, traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.5 yen to 3.6 yen per kg lower. Benchmark July was off 2.0 yen at 155.8 yen.
The death of China's paramount leader Deng Xiaoping was not a factor in the market, traders said.

Prices were lower from the outset, and the yen's rebound helped extended early losses. "The market continued to suffer from a lack of fresh incentives," a trader said. Given weak demand in producing countries, it was natural prices should ease, he said. -- Tokyo Commodities Desk +81-3-3432-7431
